_comment: P100. Ten cross-surface workflows: each vendor's web chat (claude.ai, ChatGPT, Gemini) into each vendor's desktop app, plus one round trip. Surface steps (kind sim) write only what the surface's drive_write allows, cross-checked against shared/cross-modality/transitions.json; computer steps (kind real) run the repo's own functions in a sandbox. All data is fictional. Run: python3 tools/surface_workflow_check.py. Guide: docs/SURFACE-WORKFLOWS.md.

claude_web.note: The Google Drive connector creates files and can share, move and trash them with approval; Creator OS policy is create-only.

claude_desktop.note: The computer itself: local files and the Drive for desktop mirror.

chatgpt_web_plain.note: The Google Drive app, where the plan, workspace and Google permissions allow it.

chatgpt_desktop.note: Chat and Work use the same Google Drive app; Codex works on local files.

gemini_web.note: Export to Docs saves a new Doc in My Drive; the person moves it into the hub.

gemini_desktop.note: Gemini Spark on a connected Mac folder: edits by default and can delete.

human_at_home.note: Not an AI surface: the person saving a file on the computer by hand.

gap_ledger.summary: No validated field names the vendor surface that made a hub file or job; the remote MCP connector records origin "other" (requested_by can carry a name only as unvalidated free text).
Job results do not carry the ticket's origin.
The job runner and watcher write no log file and no last-run stamp; a run log exists only if the scheduler line captures their output.
Minority reports are checked but never saved: job results have no field for one and the agent-output validator has no record option.
The google_workspace capability turns on only Gmail in the connector plan; Calendar, Drive and Docs stay off although the registry notes say they come with it.
Eight capability flags are named by no runtime Python (only declared in setup and cross-checked by the drift guard); they act only through instructions the model reads.
Profile import reads ChatGPT exports only; there is no Gemini or claude.ai export prompt.
Dated exports of voice-profile, channel-context, setup-context and content-calendar have no merge or proposal path (the probe reads skill descriptions, so a fix worded differently may not trip it).
Some Drive connectors can now move and trash files; a queued ticket trashed before the computer runs leaves no result and no record that it existed.
Doc exports (a .docx, or a .gdoc stub on a Drive for desktop mirror) skip the offline injection tier and wait for a Claude session; only text files are screened offline.
An in-session escalation that refuses a route (QUARANTINE or BLOCK) writes no ledger row.

_closed_gaps.summary: A task register re-read on every pass gained a duplicate event each time when the same task had been edited on both sides.
_closed_gaps.closed_by: P100: tools/tasks.py merge_tasks matches events across copies by every field except seq, as a multiset, and copies events before renumbering.
_closed_gaps.pinned_by: tools/tasks.py selftest merge-reread-stable; workflows W5 and W10 (tasks.merge stable)

live_steps: In claude.ai, with the Google Drive connector on, ask Claude to save your voice change as a NEW dated file in Creator OS/Profile (never to edit an existing file).
In Claude Desktop, ask Creator OS to apply that change to voice-profile.local.json; read the proposed change before it is saved.

At the next quarter-hour run (or after: python3 tools/profile_mirror.py sync --api), run python3 tools/profile_mirror.py status: the last run is ok and the "About me and my voice" Doc shows the new tone.
Run the sync a second time: it reports the Doc unchanged.

workflows.story: Queue a library analysis from the browser; run and check it from the ChatGPT desktop app's Codex view.
live_steps: In claude.ai, with the Drive connector, ask Claude to create a library_analyze job ticket in Creator OS/Jobs/queue (docs/DRIVE-HUB.md shows the ticket shape).
In the ChatGPT desktop app, open Codex on your Creator OS folder and run: python3 tools/handoff/runner.py --hub "<your hub folder>" --once

With compute_handoff_enabled off it reports gated and the ticket stays; turn it on in the wizard and run it again: Jobs/results gets a .status.json with human_review_required true and Outbox gets the report.
Whether Codex may write to a Drive folder outside the folder it opened is not documented; if it is refused, run the same command in Terminal.

live_steps: In ChatGPT on the web, run implementation/gpt/profile-import/PROMPT.md and, with the Google Drive app connected, ask ChatGPT to save the JSON as a NEW file in Creator OS/Profile.
Continue the same Work chat in the ChatGPT desktop app. In Codex, on your Creator OS folder, run: python3 tools/profile_mirror.py check-file "<the saved file>" (it prints ok, or why it was refused).
Ask Claude Desktop to propose creator-profile.local.json from the export (profile-import); conflicts between ChatGPT contexts are listed for you to decide; you save the file by hand.
The contact profile is copied to Drive only when the mirror agent was installed with --include-contact-profile.

workflows.story: Tasks edited in ChatGPT on the web and at home on the same day, with a Drive conflict copy, merge without duplicates.
live_steps: In ChatGPT on the web, ask for your task list as a NEW dated file in Creator OS/Store.
The same day, change the same task in Claude Desktop.
In Claude Desktop, ask Creator OS for the task list: both changes are there once each, and asking again does not add duplicates.

live_steps: In ChatGPT on the web, ask for a posting package: it is text only.
In the Gemini desktop app, say "post it now": Gemini has no Creator OS tools, so nothing is posted.
Posting happens only from the Scheduling Dashboard on the computer after you confirm; with live publishing off the dashboard moves the item to ready_to_post for you to post by hand.
Developer-mode variant (a Business, Enterprise or Edu workspace on ChatGPT web): a schedule_post call returns a plan with human_review_required true and does not post.

workflows.story: A Gemini chat drafts in my voice from the Doc attached from Drive; Gemini Spark edits, breaks, fixes and deletes the content calendar in a connected folder.
live_steps: In the Gemini web app, attach the hub's "About me and my voice" Doc to a chat from Google Drive and ask for a script in your voice.

If you use Gemini Spark in the Gemini app on the Mac, connect ONLY the hub's Inbox folder. If Spark ever edits your Creator OS folder, the next mirror run copies a valid edit, refuses a broken one (the Drive copy and the Doc stay as they were), and keeps the Drive copy of a deleted file.
Check with: python3 tools/profile_mirror.py status

live_steps: In the Gemini web app, use Export to Docs on a chat; it saves a new Doc in My Drive. Move it into Creator OS/Inbox.

In Claude Desktop, ask Creator OS to sort the Inbox: a text note with injected instructions is sealed in Inbox/Quarantine, a transcript is proposed for your approval, and Doc or Word files wait for a Claude session to read them.
Approve the transcript; the inbox ledger records the review.

workflows.story: Is my Drive hub on? A Gemini chat can only answer from its pasted text; the computer's connector plan is the authority.
live_steps: Ask Gemini whether the Drive hub is on: it can only repeat what its pasted instructions say, and the pasted Gemini pack's first line shows how old that text is.
In the ChatGPT desktop app, open Codex on your Creator OS folder and run: python3 shared/connectors/connectors.py --plan (this is the computer's actual answer).

live_steps: On one day: in the Gemini web app export notes to a Doc and move it into the Inbox; in ChatGPT on the web save a task list into Store; in claude.ai create a job ticket; at home change your voice profile.
Let the computer run (or run the watcher, the inbox sort and the mirror by hand), then run it all again.

Check: python3 tools/profile_mirror.py status (one ok run, the Doc unchanged on the second pass), Jobs/results (one result, no re-run), Inbox/Quarantine (the poisoned note), and the task list (each change once).
Read the result in the ChatGPT desktop app and the Gemini desktop app: both see the same Drive files.
